prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, mid 50s goddess, heavy muscle physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman; massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline; enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves; not slim, not lean; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, sculpted updo chocolate brown hair — wearing a champagne ivory silk string micro bikini top of two small opaque triangle cups tied with thin champagne ivory silk strings at her neck and back, and a minimal low-rise champagne ivory silk bottom of one tiny opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque pieces fully covering her, her stomach bare. Her waist wears a black leather waist harness of one narrow belt around her waist and a second narrow belt around her hips, joined by four thin vertical straps over her stomach with a small silver ring at every junction, framing her navel. Her left leg wears a black ribbed over-the-knee sock with two thin white stripes around the top band, hugging her left calf and knee and ending high on her left thigh, running down into her heel. Her right leg wears a black fishnet thigh-high stocking with a wide lace-trimmed top band, the diamond mesh hugging her right thigh, knee, calf and ankle and running down into her heel, her warm olive skin showing through every opening of the net, matching the rest of her body. Pose: walking confidently toward the camera, shoulders back, chin lifted — most extreme heavy muscle silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of champagne ivory silk, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in glossy champagne lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, a black leather collar with a small silver ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a long fine silver chain falls diagonally across her torso and swings down to her left hip, ending in a small silver tassel that hangs at her hip, and large drop earrings of mixed metals, a gold chain ending in a heavy silver weight on each ear, hanging above her collarbones. Jewelry is metal and pearl only.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed far beyond the extreme, every element exaggerated to the maximum: a thick opaque white eyeshadow smeared from the lash line over the whole lid and up past the brows to the temples, a wide thick white band painted under both eyes, enormous bright turquoise liner wings flaring far beyond the outer corners, extremely long clumped false lashes in double layers top and bottom, thick opaque glossy white lips with a sharp outline.

Background: a sunny harbour quay of pale stone with a waist-high iron railing, mooring posts of normal height and a white lighthouse behind her, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
